nyt.label: New York Times
nyt.description: Newsroom graphics: a headline that states the finding, values printed on the marks, series named at their own ends.
nyt.guidance:
- `title` is the finding, in a sentence; `subtitle` names the measure, the population and the unit.
- Colour can tell 5 categories apart; past that they share a grey.
nyt.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="2" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dcdcdc"/><rect x="3" y="2.4" width="7" height="1.3" fill="#121212"/><rect x="3" y="6.5" width="2.6" height="6" fill="#2f6b9a"/><rect x="6.7" y="4.9" width="2.6" height="7.6" fill="#c2352b"/><rect x="10.4" y="7.9" width="2.6" height="4.6" fill="#4a8b6f"/><path d="M2.6 12.5H13.4" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1"/></svg>

economist.label: The Economist
economist.description: Print weekly: compact, flat headline over a deck that names the measure, units repeated down the ruler.
economist.guidance:
- `subtitle` names the measure, the place and the period — "% of GDP, 2023".
- Annotate each measure with `unit` in `semantic_types`.
- The key holds 3 colours.
economist.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="2" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dcdcdc"/><rect x="2.6" y="2.3" width="4.6" height="1.6" fill="#e3120b"/><rect x="3" y="6.5" width="2.6" height="6" fill="#006ba2"/><rect x="6.7" y="4.9" width="2.6" height="7.6" fill="#3ebcd2"/><rect x="10.4" y="7.9" width="2.6" height="4.6" fill="#ebb434"/><path d="M2.6 12.5H13.4" stroke="#121317" stroke-width="1"/></svg>

variants.because: Right-hand measure axis is the house default (ggthemes theme_economist; measured opposite on 3/3 bar charts and the electricity-mix part-to-whole area). The one measured exception is a non-part-to-whole range/area band (seattle-range), which keeps y on the left.

swiss.label: Swiss
swiss.description: International Typographic Style: warm paper, a visible modular grid, black structural axes, a bold flush-left Helvetica headline over a rule, and a single signal-red accent.
swiss.guidance:
- `title` carries the naming in a bold flush-left block; `subtitle` names the measure and period.
- Annotate the measure with `unit` in `semantic_types`.
- Colour is a single signal red; the categorical key tells 5 series apart.
swiss.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="0" fill="#f4f1ea" stroke="#d9d5cc"/><rect x="3" y="6.3" width="2.6" height="6.2" fill="#e2231a"/><rect x="6.7" y="4.300000000000001" width="2.6" height="8.2" fill="#1a1a1a"/><rect x="10.4" y="7.7" width="2.6" height="4.8" fill="#0067a5"/><path d="M3 3V12.5H13.4" fill="none" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>

nature.label: Nature
nature.description: Journal figure: small panel, axis titles kept with units, statistics printed beside the fit.
nature.guidance:
- Annotate every measure with `unit` in `semantic_types`; `subtitle` names the sample, not the unit.
- Colour can tell 6 categories apart; past that they share a grey.
nature.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="2" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dcdcdc"/><rect x="3" y="6.3" width="2" height="6.2" fill="#0072b2"/><rect x="6.7" y="4.5" width="2" height="8" fill="#e69f00"/><rect x="10.4" y="7.9" width="2" height="4.6" fill="#009e73"/><path d="M3 3.2V12.5H13.4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/></svg>

mckinsey.label: McKinsey
mckinsey.description: Consulting deck: wide bands, every value printed in a column, a headline that states the takeaway.
mckinsey.guidance:
- `title` states the takeaway; `subtitle` names the measure and unit.
- Colour can tell 5 categories apart.
mckinsey.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="2" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dcdcdc"/><rect x="4" y="3.4" width="8.6" height="2.4" fill="#051c2c"/><rect x="4" y="6.9" width="6.4" height="2.4" fill="#2251ff"/><rect x="4" y="10.4" width="4.2" height="2.4" fill="#00a9f4"/><path d="M3.5 3V13" stroke="#051c2c" stroke-width="1"/></svg>

datawrapper.label: Datawrapper
datawrapper.description: Embedded web chart: narrow column, plain headline and deck, a rule under the footer.
datawrapper.guidance:
- `title` and `subtitle` do all the naming; annotate the measure with `unit`.
- Sized for a narrow column, so it reads tall rather than wide.
- Colour can tell 5 categories apart.
datawrapper.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="2" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dcdcdc"/><path d="M2.6 5.5H13.4" stroke="#b3b3b3" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M2.6 8H13.4" stroke="#b3b3b3" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M2.6 10.5H13.4" stroke="#b3b3b3" stroke-width="1"/><rect x="3" y="6" width="2.2" height="6.5" fill="#18a1cd"/><rect x="6.7" y="4" width="2.2" height="8.5" fill="#e2a233"/><rect x="10.4" y="7.5" width="2.2" height="5" fill="#c04a4a"/><path d="M2.6 12.5H13.4" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/></svg>

powerbi.label: Power BI
powerbi.description: Dashboard tile: compact, legend to the right, the latest point emphasised.
powerbi.guidance:
- Leave `title` out where the tile sits under its own caption — the axis titles come back to name the measure.
- Colour can tell 6 categories apart.
powerbi.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="2" fill="#1b1a19" stroke="#3b3a39"/><path d="M2.6 7.6H13.4" stroke="#3b3a39" stroke-width="1"/><rect x="3" y="6" width="2.6" height="6.5" fill="#118dff"/><rect x="6.7" y="4" width="2.6" height="8.5" fill="#e66c37"/><rect x="10.4" y="7.5" width="2.6" height="5" fill="#3bd1c7"/><path d="M2.6 12.5H13.4" stroke="#3b3a39" stroke-width="1"/></svg>

variants.because: a panel in a grid has no room for a dot at every reading — its own 16-panel exhibit drops them

powerbi-light.label: Power BI (light)
powerbi-light.description: Light dashboard tile: white canvas, Segoe UI, hairline grid, legend to the right.
powerbi-light.guidance:
- Leave `title` out where the tile sits under its own caption — the axis titles come back to name the measure.
- Colour can tell 6 categories apart.
powerbi-light.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="2" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d2d0ce"/><path d="M2.6 7.6H13.4" stroke="#dcdcdc" stroke-width="1"/><rect x="3" y="6" width="2.6" height="6.5" fill="#118dff"/><rect x="6.7" y="4" width="2.6" height="8.5" fill="#12239e"/><rect x="10.4" y="7.5" width="2.6" height="5" fill="#e66c37"/><path d="M2.6 12.5H13.4" stroke="#d2d0ce" stroke-width="1"/></svg>

pop.label: Pop
pop.description: A pop-art remix of Swiss: electric process colours, heavy black structure, oversized marks, and punchy display type.
pop.guidance:
- Use a short title that can carry the poster-like display treatment.
- Strong categorical or binned quantitative data makes best use of the 6-colour process key.
- Keep annotations concise; the heavy structure and high-contrast marks already speak loudly.
pop.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="2" fill="#fff200" stroke="#111111"/><rect x="2.5" y="3" width="5.5" height="5" fill="#ff1493" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="8" y="3" width="5.5" height="5" fill="#00d9ff" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="2.5" y="8" width="5.5" height="5" fill="#7a3cff" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="8" y="8" width="5.5" height="5" fill="#ff5a1f" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg>

cartoon.label: Cartoon
cartoon.description: A playful comic house: warm cream paper, a rounded comic typeface, fat dark "sticker" outlines around bright crayon-coloured bars, wedges and dots, rounded corners, chunky round-capped lines, and a soft dashed grid.
cartoon.guidance:
- `title` carries the naming in a bold rounded comic block; `subtitle` names the measure in a friendly aside.
- Annotate the measure with `unit` in `semantic_types`.
- Colour is a bright crayon set; the key tells 6 series apart.
cartoon.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="15" height="15" rx="3.5" fill="#fffdf5" stroke="#ece5d6"/><rect x="3" y="6.1" width="2.8" height="6.4" fill="#3aa9ff" rx="1.3"/><rect x="6.7" y="4.1" width="2.8" height="8.4" fill="#ff5d5d" rx="1.3"/><rect x="10.4" y="7.5" width="2.8" height="5" fill="#ffc23c" rx="1.3"/><path d="M2.6 12.5H13.4" stroke="#2e2b28" stroke-width="1.7"/></svg>
